note: One docs page per component: components-<group>-<name> → /docs/components/<group>/<name>, primitives-<group>-<name> → /docs/primitives/<group>/<name> (groups are one word: animate, backgrounds, base, buttons, community, headless, radix, effects, texts). A leftover demo-* item (its component had no registry item to attach to) is tried as that component. The ~260 icons-* items have no page of their own (only the /docs/icons gallery; /docs/icons/<name> is a 404): excluded. Variant demos such as demo-components-base-menu-checkbox map to a path that does not exist and stay url-less. Unknown names answer a real 404 (checked 2026-10-10); no robots.txt, no sitemap.
